subject: Signal and System
questionText:
For the given signals x1(t), x2(t) and x3(t) the periods
are respectively 1.08, 3.6, and 2.025 sec, then
x(t) = x1(t) + x2 (t) + x3(t) is:
 (a)
Non-periodic
(b)
Periodic with fundamental period 30
(c)
Periodic with fundamental period 32.4
(d)
Periodic with fundamental period 5
explanation: Practice Question from Signal and System DPP-05 (Signal and Systems).
